DiT-XL/2 at 256 px on 8x H20 (DDP, 32 images per GPU, global batch 256): the reference train.py (fp32 + TF32, VAE encode every step in fp32, per-parameter EMA loop, foreach AdamW) runs 0.7691 s/update; bf16 autocast + pre-computed latents + torch.compile + fused AdamW + foreach EMA 0.263 s (x2.92). bf16 autocast x1.52, then cached latents x1.68; a bf16 VAE x1.19. One change at a time from bf16 + latents (0.3019 s): compile x1.16; fused AdamW x0.98; EMA off x1.02; timm's unfused attention x0.93; cuDNN-first SDPA x1.015; torchao float8 Linear layers x0.66; 64 instead of 32 images per GPU 119 vs 106 samples/s per GPU; 32 x 1 vs 16 x 2 accumulation at a fixed global batch x1.09; an all-reduce on every micro-batch instead of no_sync x0.96; TF32 off in fp32 x0.43.

DiT on 8x H20 (32 images per GPU): bf16 + cached latents over the fp32 reference gives x2.55 on XL/2 and x7.01 on S/2; the whole stack (+ compile, fused AdamW, foreach EMA) x2.92 on XL/2 (SM utilisation 97 %) and x7.67 on S/2 (65 %). At 512 px (XL/2, 1024 tokens) bf16 runs 2.049 s/update (79.5 GiB), + cached latents x1.73, + compile + fused AdamW + foreach EMA x2.00.

torchao float8 training on H20 vs H100 (FP8 tensor cores at twice the bf16 rate on both; an H20 is rated at about 148 dense bf16 TFLOPS against about 989 for an H100 SXM, so matmuls take a larger share of its step): DiT-XL/2 (bf16 + cached latents) with float8 Linear layers x0.66 without and x1.20 with torch.compile on 8x H20, x0.43 and x0.89 on 8x H100; on top of the whole DiT stack (cached latents, compile, fused AdamW, foreach EMA) XL/2 at 256 px x1.21 on H20 vs x0.89 on H100; S/2 x0.87 vs x0.93; XL/2 at 512 px x1.19 vs x0.96; Z-Image LoRA (diffusers --do_fp8_training) x0.74 with and x0.70 without gradient checkpointing on 8x H20, x0.45 and x0.44 on 8x H100.

From 8x H100 to 8x H20 (same specs, same software; speed-up of the same change on H20 vs on H100): an H20 step is dominated by matmuls, so changes that cut memory traffic, kernel launches or communication pay less - torch.compile x1.16 vs x1.31 (DiT-XL/2), x1.08 vs x1.24 (SDXL), x1.17 vs x1.45 (FLUX.1 LoRA, cached inputs); fused AdamW x0.98 vs x1.08; ZeRO-2 over ZeRO-3 x1.11 vs x1.33 and FSDP2 over ZeRO-3 x1.13 vs x1.42 (FLUX.1 full); TF32 also matters less (TF32 off in fp32 x0.43 vs x0.32). See h20-pays-more.

From 8x H100 to 8x H20 (same specs, same software; speed-up of the same change on H20 vs on H100): changes that remove work from the step pay as much or more - cached latents x1.68 vs x1.53 (DiT-XL/2), gradient checkpointing off x1.38 vs x1.35 (FLUX.1 LoRA), cuDNN-first attention on Wan2.1 x1.29 vs x1.22; and FP8 matmuls flip sign once compiled: torchao float8 Linear layers + torch.compile on DiT-XL/2 x1.20 vs x0.89. See h20-pays-less.

SD1.5 UNet full fine-tune (diffusers train_text_to_image.py, 512 px, 16 images per GPU) on 8x H20: bf16 0.9236 s/update (36.0 GiB); fp32 x0.39, fp32 + TF32 x0.43; torch.compile x1.09; cuDNN-first SDPA x1.06; xformers x1.008; gradient checkpointing x0.86; 8-bit Adam x0.95; 32 per GPU 18.6 vs 17.3 samples/s per GPU.

SDXL UNet full fine-tune (diffusers train_text_to_image_sdxl.py, 1024 px, 4 images per GPU, gradient checkpointing) on 8x H20: 1.389 s/update (61.1 GiB); without checkpointing x1.22 (79.5 GiB); xformers x1.009; torch.compile x1.08; 8 per GPU 3.23 vs 2.88 samples/s per GPU (60.9 GiB).

FLUX.1-dev LoRA r32 at 1024 px, batch 1 per GPU on 8x H20 (diffusers): the reference (captions through CLIP + T5 and images through the VAE every step, gradient checkpointing, SDPA) 2.741 s (36.9 GiB); checkpointing off x1.38 (61.1 GiB); one instance prompt with its embeddings and the latents cached x1.05 (a workload change: no captions); with both caches xformers x1.13, torch.compile x1.17; 4 per GPU 0.383 vs 0.365 samples/s per GPU.

FLUX.1-dev LoRA r32 in DiffSynth-Studio (bf16 weights, text and images encoded every step, gradient checkpointing, torch SDPA) on 8x H20: 2.919 s (38.4 GiB); cuDNN-first SDPA x1.12; checkpointing off x1.36 (72.8 GiB).

Z-Image-Turbo (6.15B) LoRA r32 at 1024 px, batch 1 per GPU on 8x H20: diffusers 1.952 s (20.3 GiB), checkpointing off x1.39 (45.3 GiB), torchao float8 training x0.74 and x0.70 without checkpointing; DiffSynth-Studio 2.096 s (24.4 GiB), flash-attn-4 x1.07, torch SDPA x0.992 over FlashAttention-2.
